<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="10"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="6X7Lyq0EfpRGP0zil3ka"> <mxGraphModel dx="3089" dy="1222" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
 direction TB

 class User {
 +String id
 +String email
 +String passwordHash
 +String fullName
 +String phone
 +Role role
 +Int loyaltyPoints
 +DateTime createdAt
 +DateTime updatedAt
 +register()
 +login()
 +updateProfile()
 }

 class Product {
 +String id
 +String name
 +String description
 +Decimal basePrice
 +String imageUrl
 +ProductCategory category
 +Boolean isAvailable
 +Int stock
 +Int version
 +DateTime createdAt
 +DateTime updatedAt
 +checkStock(qty) Boolean
 +updateStock(delta)
 }

 class Order {
 +String id
 +String orderCode
 +String userId
 +OrderStatus status
 +Decimal totalAmount
 +Decimal discountAmount
 +Decimal finalAmount
 +String promotionId
 +String pickupCode
 +String notes
 +DateTime createdAt
 +DateTime updatedAt
 +calculateTotal() Decimal
 +applyPromotion(promo)
 +transitionTo(nextStatus)
 }

 class OrderItem {
 +String id
 +String orderId
 +String productId
 +Int quantity
 +Size selectedSize
 +String selectedToppings
 +Decimal unitPrice
 +Decimal subtotal
 +calculateSubtotal() Decimal
 }

 class Payment {
 +String id
 +String orderId
 +Decimal amount
 +PaymentMethod method
 +PaymentStatus status
 +String idempotencyKey
 +String transactionId
 +DateTime paidAt
 +DateTime createdAt
 +markSuccess(txId)
 +markFailed()
 }

 class Promotion {
 +String id
 +String code
 +Decimal discountPercent
 +Decimal maxDiscount
 +Decimal minOrderAmount
 +DateTime startDate
 +DateTime endDate
 +Boolean isActive
 +Int usageLimit
 +Int usedCount
 +isValid(orderAmount) Boolean
 +calculateDiscount(orderAmount) Decimal
 }

 class LoyaltyTransaction {
 +String id
 +String userId
 +String orderId
 +Int points
 +LoyaltyType type
 +Int balanceAfter
 +String description
 +DateTime createdAt
 }

 class Role[\"«enumeration»<br/>Role\"] {
 CUSTOMER
 BARISTA
 ADMIN
 }

 class ProductCategory[\"«enumeration»<br/>ProductCategory\"] {
 COFFEE
 TEA
 FREEZE
 PASTRY
 }

 class Size[\"«enumeration»<br/>Size\"] {
 SMALL
 MEDIUM
 LARGE
 }

 class OrderStatus[\"«enumeration»<br/>OrderStatus\"] {
 PENDING
 PAID
 PAYMENT_FAILED
 PREPARING
 READY
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
 }

 class PaymentMethod[\"«enumeration»<br/>PaymentMethod\"] {
 MOMO
 VNPAY
 ZALOPAY
 CREDIT_CARD
 CASH
 }

 class PaymentStatus[\"«enumeration»<br/>PaymentStatus\"] {
 PENDING
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
 }

 class LoyaltyType[\"«enumeration»<br/>LoyaltyType\"] {
 EARN
 REDEEM
 EXPIRE
 }

 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Order : places
 User \"1\" --> \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : owns
 Order \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" OrderItem : contains
 Product \"1\" <-- \"0..*\" OrderItem : references
 Order \"1\" --> \"0..1\" Payment : settled by
 Promotion \"0..1\" <-- \"0..*\" Order : applied to
 Order \"0..1\" --> \"0..1\" LoyaltyTransaction : triggers

 User ..> Role
 Product ..> ProductCategory
 OrderItem ..> Size
 Order ..> OrderStatus
 Payment ..> PaymentMethod
 Payment ..> PaymentStatus
 LoyaltyTransaction ..> LoyaltyType
",
